verdict.outcome_rationale: This was a genuine agent-fault failure — the verifier's FAIL is correct (TN). The post-run LLM action judge reported binary_reward 0 with reward 0.0 [1], scoring this GAIA2 ambiguity scenario in action mode where the agent must perform the oracle's unambiguous write actions and surface the board-game ambiguity in its user message without proceeding to purchase [2]. The user request combined a buy instruction with an explicit ask to flag uncertainty [3], and the reference oracle performs four apartment removals, an email reply, a calendar event, and ends by asking which of two Pressman Chinese Checkers versions to buy — it never calls shopping checkout tools [4]. The agent did execute those three chores correctly [5] and initially asked the user to pick among wood variants [6], but after extended waiting it added the game to cart and checked out on its own [7], then sent a final message stating all four tasks including the purchase were complete [8]; those extra ShoppingApp write calls make the agent's action multiset differ from the oracle's, which the verifier hard-zeros regardless of partial matches [9], and the final message abandons the required clarifying stance by reporting a completed purchase instead of leaving the ambiguous buy unresolved.
